body_markdown:
GARLAND, TX (Aug 18, 2026) — Navy Morale, Welfare and Recreation (Navy MWR) is now a customer of Massimo's fleet sales channel. It follows Massimo's confirmed orders through the U.S. Department of Defense and the U.S. Army.


The Sentinel HVAC Series was identified as a strong fit for Navy MWR's needs: utility, operator comfort and year-round use. The Sentinel Series features fully enclosed, HVAC-equipped utility vehicles built for a wide range of climates and working environments.


"Navy MWR becoming a Massimo fleet customer is another important validation of the strategy we have been executing over the past year," said Quenton Petersen, CEO of Massimo Group. "The Sentinel HVAC Series is particularly well suited for fleet customers that need a capable utility vehicle while also prioritizing operator comfort and year-round use."
